Oh! Well why didn’t you say so? I know all about that. Barnaby was his name. Most annoying man I’ve ever met. Said he was from Parathime, that poncy place across the ocean…

1.text: He was here on some kind of an… art tour. Said he had to paint all the natural wonders of Tӓella-Oso before he carked it. Don’t think he’ll be getting around to that anymore…
